item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00232","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C10","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 is a highly specific, nearly line-for-line template for the child. Both proclamations recite a February 11, 1952 statute suspending duties on a metal; quote a proviso requiring Tariff Commission notice when the monthly market price falls below 18 cents per pound; report the Commission's finding; and proclaim revocation effective for articles entered or withdrawn from warehouse after the proclamation date. The child principally substitutes zinc, its tariff paragraphs, Public Law 258, and the June reporting period for C22's lead-specific details. C10 has analogous finding-triggered termination of a tax suspension but materially less shared language. C25 shares tariff-administration terminology and Commission-based machinery but performs a duty modification rather than revoking a statutory suspension.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the import duties on zinc-bearing ores ... and on zinc in blocks, pigs, and slabs ... have been suspended by Public Law 258, 82d Congress, approved February 11, 1952","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the import duties ... on lead-bearing ores ... [and forms of lead] have been suspended by Public Law 257, 82d Congress, approved February 11, 1952","explanation":"The opening recital uses the same statutory-suspension frame, changing the metal, tariff provisions, and adjacent public-law number."},{"child_excerpt":"when, for any one calendar month during such period, the average market price of slab zinc ... has been below 18 cents per pound, the Tariff Commission, within fifteen days ... shall so advise the President","parent_excerpt":"when, for any one calendar month during such period ... the average market price of common lead ... has been below 18 cents per pound, the Tariff Commission, within fifteen days ... shall so advise the President","explanation":"The distinctive price-trigger and Commission-notification proviso is reproduced almost verbatim and adapted from lead to zinc."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim the revocation of the suspension of duties provided for in the said Public Law 258, such revocation to be effective with respect to articles entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption after the date of this proclamation","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim the revocation of the suspension of duties provided for in the said Public Law 257, such revocation to be effective with respect to articles entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption after the date of this proclamation","explanation":"The operative clause is essentially identical apart from the public-law number."}]}
